subject: Computação
description_pt: Avaliar a veracidade, credibilidade e relevância da informação em seus diferentes formatos, sendo capaz de identificar o propósito pelo qual foi disseminada. Selecionar e utilizar tecnologias computacionais para se expressar e resolver problemas, analisando criticamente os diferentes impactos na sociedade.

components.description_pt: Avaliar a veracidade e credibilidade de informações em diferentes formatos digitais
components.description_en: Evaluate the truthfulness and credibility of information across different digital formats
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the clarity and accuracy of scientific information presented in various media formats

components.description_pt: Identificar o propósito pela qual uma informação foi disseminada
components.description_en: Identify the purpose for which a piece of information was disseminated

components.description_pt: Selecionar tecnologias computacionais apropriadas para expressar ideias ou resolver problemas específicos
components.description_en: Select appropriate computational technologies to express ideas or solve specific problems
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate tools, technologies, or models to analyze a given scientific data set

components.description_pt: Analisar criticamente os impactos variados de tecnologias computacionais na sociedade
components.description_en: Analyze varied impacts of computational technologies on society critically
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

cc_matches.description: Communicate scientific and/or technical information orally and/or in written formats, including various forms of media and may include tables, diagrams, and charts.
Analyze data using tools, technologies, and/or models (e.g., computational, mathematical) in order to make valid and reliable scientific claims or determine an optimal design solution.

Evaluate a solution to a complex real-world problem based on prioritized criteria and trade-offs that account for a range of constraints, including cost, safety, reliability, and aesthetics as well as possible social, cultural, and environmental impacts.
